records.context: A technician timed each quick bench check with a lap timer, recording minutes before the colon and seconds after it.
Maintenance planners list multi-hour work packages, using hours to the left of the colon and minutes to its right.
HR time tracking gives hours as a decimal quantity: a quarter-hour is .25, not 25 minutes.
The integration event carries a machine-readable elapsed interval encoded with ISO-8601 P/T/H/M/S duration notation.
Contractor export stores worked hours using a dot and base-ten fractional hours rather than a colon.
Short stopwatch measurements are written as minutes then seconds, for instance two minutes ten seconds is 2:10.
Elapsed labor estimate uses an hour count and a two-digit minute field, separated by a colon; this is not a clock time.
Scheduled-job API returns a duration in ISO 8601 notation, e.g. P2DT3H indicates elapsed days and hours.
